name: Arc
author: ultralazr
description: William Duddell's singing arc from 1899: an arc lamp turned into an oscillator. Each voice goes from a clean sine to a reedy buzz to a screaming relaxation tone as you raise the current. Plasma noise makes the pitch wander. A second lamp can lock to the first, beat against it or go chaotic.
credits: Musica Obscura by ultralazr, from op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
